title: A Tale of Three Pillows…
text:
A Tale of Three Pillows…. When I ordered two of these TEMPUR-PEDIC COMFORTPILLOW TRAVEL PILLOWS (One Size, Beige), one pillow turned out to be overstuffed (very fat, heavy, and rather hard), and the other turned out to be perfect (moderately flat and flexible). Both are excellent small pillows, though the fat one is more suitable for a lumbar pillow or “propping-up” pillow than a travel pillow.

Why are the two pillows so different? It’s because they are NOT solid-core pillows like my wonderful [[ASIN:B07CMK551C full-size Tempur-Pedic Symphony Pillow]], which is a “100% molded viscoelastic polyurethane foam pad”. Instead, the travel pillows consist of “70% shredded visco elastic polyurethane foam” and “30% visco elastic polyurethane foam pad”.

My fat pillow obviously received more shredded foam during manufacture than the more flexible pillow. Because shredded foam tends to shift in pillows, I try to avoid pillows with shredded foam fill. In fact, I wouldn’t have purchased the two travel pillows had I known that they weren’t solid-core.

However, I like my two travel pillows pretty well--so far the fill hasn’t shifted. They are good quality pillows made with Tempur-Pedic memory foam that conforms to one’s body. They work for me because the small size is very good for propping up an arm or leg in bed, or for providing spot support for back, neck, or shoulders in a chair.

product_metadata.title: Tempur-Pedic Comfort Pillow Soft Feel, Travel
features: TRAVEL SIZE MEMORY FOAM PILLOW—Legendary TEMPUR-Pedic comfort and support, scaled down to create a small travel pillow unlike any other.
PERSONALIZED COMFORT—A plush TEMPUR material sleeve filled with micro-cushions in this travel pillow adjusts to your shape to relieve pressure.
PERFECTED FOR YOU—This memory foam travel pillow is expertly engineered to relieve pressure and provide personalized support throughout the night, and return to shape in the morning.
WASHABLE & REMOVABLE COVER — Simply remove the allergen-resistant cover and toss in the wash to keep your small travel pillow feeling and looking fresh.
DURABLE & RELIABLE—Adaptive TEMPUR material never loses its shape, offering superior support and alignment year after year.
description: Once you get the revolutionary alignment and support of a TEMPUR pillow, it’s hard to leave it at home. With our travel-sized TEMPUR-Comfort Pillow, you can take the comfort you love wherever you go. This traditionally-shaped travel memory foam pillow offers the same plush comfort and conforming support as the original, all in a smaller format perfect for carry-ons. TEMPUR material never loses its shape, so you’ll get personalized support and pressure-relief for your head, neck, and shoulders trip after trip. Plus, the removable, washable, and allergen-resistant cover keeps your small memory foam pillow feeling fresh after every use. Get the travel size memory foam pillow backed by TEMPUR innovation—it’s your key to a perfect night’s sleep, anywhere.
